newsitem.title: USA: Canada spot natgas higher in West on short supply.
newsitem.headline: Canada spot natgas higher in West on short supply.

text.p: Canadian spot natgas prices for May moved higher Tuesday as NOVA drafted gas off the system, thereby tightening supplies available to the market, industry sources said.
May gas at the AECO storage hub in Alberta was talked mostly at C$1.80 per gigajoule (GJ), up an average of six cents from Monday and about 30 cents higher than April 1.

"It's plant turnaround time so they're taking supply out of the market. It's just strictly a shortage of supply," one Calgary-based trader said, referring to the extensive spring maintenance schedule.
